rule: register-then-compute, Fable addendum 2: nothing below is chosen. The window comes from the registered window rule, the cutoff from the registered split rule, the grid from admission_v2 on the store and the labels from the registered evaluator-only label. No neural number exists yet and no brain has been run on this dataset.

initial_states.rule: pinned offline from any recorded trade of the launch; the local node is pruned and no historical eth_call is made. PLAN.md 7.12.

split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block), T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0
split.learning_entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + 902 <= T

geometric_ceiling.rule: the number of non-overlapping 932-second slots (902 s plus one tick) between the first LEARNING tick with at least one v2-eligible candidate and T - 902

grid.stable_id_rule: assigned once over the reconstructible native launches in launch order (launch_block, launched_at, curve); never from the address spelling's sort position

label_class_balance.note: computed with the evaluator-only label on the FROZEN grid, market-only. It creates no trade, alters no bankroll and produces no reinforcement; its known-answer test against the sixteen settled D10 entries was written and run first.

correction.what: the first write of this file put T at t0 + 30,210 s. The registered rule is T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second grid, and 0.7 * 43200 is 30239.999999999996 in float64, whose floor is 30239 and whose snapped value is 30,210 — one tick early.
correction.fix: the floor is computed in integer arithmetic, (7 * span) // 10, which is the rule as registered. T moves from t0 + 30,210 to t0 + 30,240, one 30-second tick later.
correction.when: before any neural number existed. The correction is arithmetic and is not informed by any result: no brain had been run, no score, AUC or interval existed, and the only numbers observed were the row count and the class balance, which moved from 5,182 / 489 / 4,536 to 5,175 / 488 / 4,531 — the one tick's worth of rows.
